upload.title: Upload a package
upload.lead: Bring a SIGame .siq pack or an OpenQuester .oq export. You'll see what's inside before anything is uploaded.
upload.guestHelp: A package needs an owner who can come back to it. Sign in with Discord to upload, and your packages stay with your account.
upload.discordUnavailable: Discord sign-in isn't switched on for this site yet, so uploading isn't available here.
upload.formats: SIGame .siq (formats 4 and 5) or OpenQuester .oq. Images, audio and video inside the file are uploaded too.

readErrors.notZip: This file is damaged or isn't a package archive.

readErrors.badContentXml: The package description inside this .siq file is broken.
readErrors.noContentJson: This .oq file has no content.json, so there's nothing to read.
readErrors.badContentJson: The package description inside this .oq file is broken.

upload.noQuestions: There are no playable questions in this file, so there's nothing to upload.

warnings.externalMedia: Linked media ({{detail}}) can't be uploaded and was left out.
warnings.emptyQuestion: Question has no text or media, so it was skipped.
warnings.noAnswer: Question has no answer. The showman will judge it without one.
